text:
Mina (People Ops): Heads-up — Owen starts Mon. I put together a minimal manager+HR checklist so week0 isn't chaotic. Quick + please flag gaps.

Eli (Eng Manager): Looks solid. My week0 goal: Owen merges a tiny onboarding PR so he touches code review flow.

Sam (HR): We'll send payroll/tax packet day0 and run a 20-min benefits intro on day3. Also recommend manager sets 1:1 weekly starting week0.

Noor (IT): Need laptop choice + shipping address. Also decide MFA policy: enforce day0 or allow day1 grace?

Owen (New Hire): MacBook Air ok. MFA day0 fine. Address same as offer.

OnboardBot: Welcome Owen! :tada: Checklist created: device order, Slack/GH invites, payroll forms, security training. Reminders scheduled.

Eli (Eng Manager): Manager checklist (short):
- Day0: 30-min intro + env setup with IT/buddy.
- Day1: join standup + pick onboarding issue.
- Day2: pair on CI/runbook.
- Day3: benefits + payroll check.
- EOW: 30-min sync to set 30/60/90.

Sam (HR): 30/60/90 template suggestion (outcome-focused):
30d: env ready + merged onboarding PR (metric: PR merged)
60d: ship small feature (metric: story accepted)
90d: present learnings (metric: doc PR + short demo)

Noor (IT): Okta + GitHub invites queued, device ordered. I'll enable MFA day0.

Mina (People Ops): Great — Eli please send calendar invites for env setup, benefits, and EOW sync. We'll mark onboarding complete in the tracker if EOW success = Slack joined, env working, onboarding PR opened/merged, compliance training started.

Eli (Eng Manager): Sent invites + created onboarding issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/issues/88

Owen (New Hire): Got invites and access. Thanks everyone — excited to start! :wave:
